notes: Built from live test fetches on 2026-11-10 (08:10-08:45 UTC). waveBuoy = the two nearest open-coast buoys whose latest record was within 24 h of its own fetch (any of the five countries; cross-border allowed and labelled by country). nearestDisplayableBuoy = nearest one within 150 km whose licence permits display today (excludes CC BY-NC, Puertos del Estado and third-party WaveNet feeds). Model: NOT RUN for any spot (Open-Meteo marine API answered 429 daily limit on 2026-11-10); model.pointsToCheck lists the three points to query after the 00:00 UTC reset (beach = catalogue pin; seaward2km = 2 km along the seaward bearing; appMarine9km = marinePoint(), 0.08 deg seaward, src/data/coast.ts). Wind: nearest IEM <CC>__ASOS station (PT, ES, FR, GB, IE, GI) with a METAR within 6 h of the check.
